comment: Dashboard layout for the CYD, applied at build time. Fixed 3x2 grid: row 0-2, col 0-1 (up to 6 components). Each component may set row and col; omit them to auto-place in the next free cell. Set expand:true to fill the rest of the row when the other column is free. WiFi and the MQTT broker are still configured at runtime on the device's web page.
